objective: Linearize automatic command/review side effects with user-confirmed shutdown so no automatic side effect can occur after shutdown is durably closed.
required_changes: Add one coordinator-local linearization boundary covering fresh automatic admission, pending/no-replay journal transition, external command send or review tick, final journal update, and shutdown admission_closed persistence/action start. The observable order must be either action fully before shutdown close or shutdown close before action denial; never a side effect after the close record.

Use a reentrant/appropriate lock without changing durable owner/session/authority checks. Do not deadlock adapter calls or prevent explicit user shutdown from eventually progressing; document the ordering invariant in code.

Concurrent regression A: block command send after admission while shutdown starts; shutdown must not be durably closed until the in-flight send linearizes, then later sends are zero. Concurrent regression B: shutdown closes first, then blocked command/tick resumes and produces send/review/pause action zero with journal unchanged.
Cover tick versus shutdown similarly, preserve ended/metadata gates, positive delivery, no replay and at-most-once shutdown.
constraints: Bounded concurrency correction only; do not modify predecessor packages, docs, PLAN, state or ledger. No external OMP, reboot, delegation, commit, publish, deploy or Docker.
Use apply_patch; run focused threaded tests, lifecycle/predecessor regressions, graphify update and residue check.
